sentences.text:
Vivek vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 September, 2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:42678
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Jabalpur

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal
On The 4 th Of September, 2025
Misc. Criminal Case No. 33839 of 2025

Vikash Gautam
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh

Appearance:
 Shri Deepak Tiwari - Advocate for the applicant.

Shri Santosh Yadav - G.A for the respondent/State.
 With
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 34769 of 2025
 Vivek
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
Shri Sanjay Sharma - Advocate for the applicant.

Shri Santosh Yadav - G.A for the respondent/State.
 Order

This first applicant under Section 483 of BNSS/439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.347/2025 registered at Police Station Wara Seoni, District Balaghat (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 419, 420, 120B, 467, 468, 471 of IPC.
The applicant is in custody since 18.07.2025.

2. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicants is that they by making forged documents committed fraud upon the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:42678 2 MCRC-33839-2025 complainant.
Therefore, case was registered against the applicants under the aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that applicants are innocent and have been falsely implicated in this case.
They are in custody since 18.07.2025.
It is further submitted that applicants have not forged any of the documents.
Nothing has been seized from them.
There is no criminal record of applicants.
The conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicants may be released on bail.

sentences.text: 4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application and prayed for it's rejection.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicants on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicants is allowed.

6. It is directed that applicants be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) each with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for their regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that they shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

They shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of B.N.S.S.
7.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the preconditions of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:42678 3 MCRC-33839-2025 8.
Accordingly, the application stands allowed.
Certified copy as per rules.
